title: Resolution urging Albany to require insurers cover embryo genetic screening
summary: Res 447 calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation requiring insurance companies to cover Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidy (PGT-A), a screening used during IVF to check embryos for chromosomal abnormalities. The resolution notes PGT-A can cost an additional $3,000 to $6,000 per IVF cycle and is often excluded from insurance coverage as an optional add-on. It argues this cost should not be a barrier to parenthood.
